text: The purpose of this report is to advise of the results of Request for Tender Doc5349386217, Contract Number 25ECS-MI-01HC, for the Sludge Storage Tanks Cleaning and Biofilter Upgrades at the Highland Creek Treatment Plant, to seek authority to reallocate project costs and cash flows within Toronto Water's 2026 Capital Budget and 2027-2035 Capital Plan in the amount of $5,041,274 net of all applicable taxes and charges ($5,130,000 net of Harmonized Sales Tax recoveries) from projects that have been completed under budget and to request authority to enter into an agreement with ASCO Construction (Toronto) Ltd., in the amount of $27,996,247 net of all applicable taxes and charges ($28,488,981 net of Harmonized Sales Tax recoveries) and a period of 104 weeks from the date that the written Order to Commence Work is issued by the City, all in accordance with the terms, conditions and…
